notes.sol: The same source confirms the F and pairwise t results. These are effect-size reporting discrepancies, not failures of the principal interaction or the underlying substantive finding.
notes.claude: C1 and C2 are P2 under R2. No paper alternative under R7. Reconciled with the second labeller (see reconciliation.md). The final judgement is the structured label; notes_blind_original keeps the pre-reconciliation blind notes, which are historical and superseded wherever they conflict with the final label.
notes.claude_blind_original_historical: Report headline says results are 'fully computationally reproducible' with only a 'minor reporting discrepancy' in two Study 5 effect sizes; hence 'computationally reproducible' as an acceptable alternative. Under the gold rules the printed C1/C2 numbers differ from the shipped output (swapped), so claim-level discrepant. I verified the swap directly in the shipped rendered HTML (afex nice() table).
